g.text: PLAY / CHORD MAP
Default view. Eight chords in the physical pad layout.
PLAY / BORROW PREVIEW
Silent live preview while BORROW is held.
PLAY / SUS4 PREVIEW
Header retains played chord; grid shows the next choices.
CHORDS / CLEAN DEFAULTS
Global harmony settings, separate from PLAY.
STRUM / EXPRESSION
Alternating direction, independent timing and velocity variation.
EDIT ONE CHORD
Inverted chord; bass still ROOT. Eight controls, one page.
IDEAS / CONTROLS
Knob 1: ON/OFF. Knob 2: STYLE: SAFE/COLOR/WILD. Knob 3: NEW.
IDEAS / PAD MAP
A5-A8 above A1-A4, matching the left chord pads.
IDEAS / TO Am
Lower pads: Bm7b5, E7, Am, SUB. Play the path yourself.
IDEAS / TRY A CHORD
Selected pad, sounding chord and short explanation.
BORROW LOCKED
Shift + BORROW latches. The boxed B stays visible.
MELODY / NEW DEFAULTS
SCALE, octave -1, ADAPT ON. Existing projects retain choices.
BASS
B.NTE: ROOT or LOW; B.OCT stays independent.
SEQ / 16 STEPS
R.PRT selects recording; PART selects step editing.
SEQ / QUANTIZE 70%
Non-destructive strength; original recording timing is retained.
SEQ / LONG CHORD
Explicit LEN holds across cells. Old steps still use GATE.
SEQ / RECORD ARMED
Waiting for Move Play. Chord takes use RATE grid and pad velocity.
SEQ / BASS OVERDUB
Record only bass over saved chords. Left pads select bass roots.
CHORD STEP / HOLD
Temporary ROOT, EXT, LEN and VEL editor. Release to return.
BASS PAGE / STEP HOLD
Bass page automatically selects bass steps and their editor.
MIDI / FOUR PARTS
Chords, melody, bass and ARP: one routing page.
THEORY
Actual sounding notes, including independent bass.
STOP PAD
Above SUS4: release all notes and stop the loop.
EDIT WITH BORROW LOCK
The badge marks prepared harmony; EDIT shows the saved pad.
EDIT / INDEPENDENT BASS
B.NTE B1; Shift + knob 8 changes octave.
LIVE BASS / F + Em
Header F/E; grid retains each pad chord.
ARP / EIGHT CONTROLS
Separate clocked part; press Move Play to run.
ARP / SYNC CLOCK
SYNC follows Move transport. FREE BPM is disabled.
ARP / FREE CLOCK
Play a chord without Move Play. Own tempo: 30-300 BPM.
ARP / CHORD PULSES
Whole voicing at RATE; RANGE is inactive in this mode.
CHORDS / PEDAL
CC64 sustain, separate from melody and bass.
BASS / PAD VELOCITY
VEL PAD follows attack. Independent SUST on knob 6.
MELODY / OWN SUSTAIN
Independent OFF, HOLD or PEDAL on knob 5.
